output: You're right that setting up permissions so each of your fifty budget owners sees only their own cost center takes deliberate planning, and we don't pretend otherwise. Our onboarding includes role-based templates and a guided permissions session, so your team isn't starting from a blank page. For a comparable case, [PLACEHOLDER] customer story: mid-market company scoped cost-center access in onboarding. If it would help, I'd suggest a 30-minute permissions design session with a solutions consultant, where we can map your budget owners to cost centers and see how much of the setup the templates already cover.
